quest.title: Unfathomable Defenses
quest.description: The Nilotpala Cup continues. With many clues collected, new opportunities seem to have emerged.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Hardy Two-Blades
dialogues.text: It's you. The uncultured swine of the Nilotpala Cup.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you potty mouth! What's your problem?

dialogues.speaker: Hardy Two-Blades
dialogues.text: The way you dote on your Fungi. It's pathetic. What a joke! You make a mockery of the philosophy of the greatest beast-tamer of all, the mighty Haniyyah.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Greatest beast-tamer of all"? That's debatable.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll set her "philosophy" straight.

dialogues.speaker: Hardy Two-Blades
dialogues.text: You keep telling yourself that! You were never gonna come close to facing Haniyyah. Time for you to go home!

dialogues.speaker: Hardy Two-Blades
dialogues.text: Nooo! This can't be happening... I trained my Fungi non-stop... Maybe I should have been harder on them?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew. Well, we beat him... but somehow Paimon isn't really in the mood to celebrate.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon. I made it through!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's amazing, Layla! You've reached your goal!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Congratulations!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I heard you won against the unstoppable Hardy Two-Blades... But you don't seem too happy about it. How come?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's just that... He was really mean. He said some weird things...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Layla the details of the match...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I see what you mean... Yeah, somehow beast-tamers like him make me feel a little... sad.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sad?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Yeah. He clearly doesn't know anything about Haniyyah. He's just making assumptions about what she's like based on a vague impression, and even trying to copy her. I'm sure Haniyyah would feel uneasy about it too, if she knew.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Also, he's so cruel to his shroom buddies, when they could have been friends... It's not just his loss, either. It brings all the other contestants down.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right! You have the right mindset, Layla! If only everyone was like you, this whole tournament would feel a lot less gloomy!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: But it's only because I'm not aiming as high... I just wanna be able to take Twirly-Whirly back to live with me, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Looks like the next fight is you against me. Let's just try to enjoy ourselves. It doesn't matter who wins, this is just a little contest between friends.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You have a deal!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Time to see who's the strongest Fungi, Twirly-Whirly or Bongo-Head! Loser buys dinner for the winner!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Whatever deal this is, you seem very happy about it. Did I miss anything big while I was gone?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Miko, you're back — finally! You snuck off without saying anything last time, so we didn't get to tell you about the evidence we— Ahem! Uh, evidently we have some things to discuss with you...!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Yes, well, it's been quite the ordeal for me, too. I only entered this tournament for a bit of fun, but now I've ended up in the semifinals. I've barely had any time at all to spend with Souka and the others gathering source material for the novel.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I'm sure you two will have a wonderful time in your fun-and-friendly match. I, on the other hand, have to take mine a little more seriously. I'm up against that stubborn young lady, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Yeah, who knew it'd get to this point... Miss Yae has to face off against Haniyyah...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look on the bright side! Maybe Miko will help us defeat Haniyyah!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But that means we won't get to show Haniyyah the error of her ways ourselves... Whatever, Paimon just doesn't want to see Miko lose!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I'm feeling nervous, but excited at the same time!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: You don't have to go easy on me. Twirly-Whirly and team have weathered plenty of tough challenges already, and they know how to put up a good fight! So you and your shroom buddies can give it your all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well then, prepare for battle, Layla and Twirly!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Oh shoot, we lost...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: But you and the gang put on the best show I've seen so far, Twirly-Whirly! That was a real blast, I loved it!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Thank you all! Twirly-Whirly and I went out with a bang. Any other opponent, and we might be feeling a little disappointed right now... but we were definitely beaten by the best.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You did really well too, y'know! Felt like we were one wrong move away from a very mushy Bongo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just letting the Fungi do their thing and enjoying the match with no pressure to win... It was a good feeling.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps this is how all competitions should be...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If only every match could be as carefree as that... Meanwhile, Miko's busy duking it out with Haniyyah. Paimon's so nervous for her! Let's go see how she's doing!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Huh? How did you find me here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We followed Pyro-1's tracks. We're a little worried about you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second... Are you comforting Pyro-1!?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: "The irony," I know... and I'd probably be enjoying it, if Pyro-1 were any other animal than a Fungi.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: The next time we meet will be in the finals. Whatever you have to say, save it for if you beat me...

choices.text: We want to understand where you're coming from.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: The fox lady said you might say that... You're pure of heart, kind, and believe the best in things.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: You wouldn't understand if I tried to explain, so here — read this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, what is it?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: These are my ancestors' records. They were attacked by a horde of Fungi in the rainforest, and many people were seriously injured.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: There was nothing exceptional about this incident at the time, and it certainly never made it into any official records. But my family have been reading it to me since I was a child, constantly warning me of the grave threat that Fungi pose to us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's what happened... No wonder you're so hostile towards Fungi.

choices.text: We're sorry about your past.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! And anyway, doesn't your family's experience make this tournament all the more meaningful? The Wisdom Orb finally means that humans and Fungi can live in peace together...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: It's not as simple as turning bad Fungi into nice Fungi with the Wisdom Orb. Plenty of scholars have experimented with similar things in my village in the past.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: But every one of them failed, gave up, and moved on. Even this new Wisdom Orb can only suppress the Fungi's aggressive nature temporarily. Without this device, they're still extremely dangerous creatures.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: On top of that, the Orb's Intellectual Boost makes the Fungi unnaturally strong. Too much elemental energy in one place is not a good idea, especially for people in poor shape already. If you've got a sensitive constitution and you start using a Wisdom Orb, you're gonna start experiencing symptoms pretty quickly.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Unnaturally strong...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, Layla's been coughing a lot lately... Could that be because of the Wisdom Orb?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: As you'll be well aware by now, all Kautilya cares about is his precious research. He just wants to expand his influence and increase the profile of the beast-tamer event.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Meanwhile, Elchingen's taking advantage of the situation. Impressed by Kautilya's research, he invested a huge sum into promoting the tournament, consequently lowering everyone's guard against the Fungi...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I don't trust either of them, period. I don't believe highly aggressive creatures like the Fungi can co-exist with humans. But I'm just another retired mercenary, so who's gonna listen to me?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: All I can do is play by their rules until victory is mine. Then I'll fight for the outcome I'm hoping for, and keep them from getting their way.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I initially had a sliver of hope that you might help me in my endeavors... guess that was pretty naive of me. But it doesn't matter what you think about all this, or what you think of me. I'm going to beat you, and then there will be nothing you can do to stop me.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Haniyyah!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: This notebook is just a relic from my past now. Do whatever you want with it, because come the day of the final, I'm going to declare the execution of all Fungi... including Pyro-1.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: It's time to say goodbye to the past.

choices.text: But things are different now.
We want to help you see the Fungi differently.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh...? It's over already? And why's the atmosphere so heavy... Does this mean Miko won!?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Your match is over too? You took your time. I'm assuming it was a close call...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sound way too relaxed for someone who's just fought in the semifinals. Bet it was a walk in the park, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Ahaha, yes, ours was as far from a close call as you could get. All it took was a few short, sharp strikes for Blitzara and I...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: ...to be beaten by Haniyyah.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: ...What, you think this is funny? Am I a joke to you?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hehe, far from it, Haniyyah. I know full well how serious you are about all this from your iron-clad determination to annihilate an entire species... How would I ever dare mock you?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: That said, if you continue down this path and find that it leads somewhere quite different from what you had hoped... what will become of that iron-clad determination then? I look forward to finding out.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: That's... not your concern.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Running away so soon?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Miss Yae lost the match, but why is Haniyyah the one who seemed upset...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: The situation gets more interesting with each development... Blitzara injured Pyro-1 soon after the match started, and Haniyyah was clearly quite distressed.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I simply pointed out that she's still deceiving herself, and her defenses began breaking down. She's more fragile than I'd imagined.

choices.text: Deceiving herself?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean, Haniyyah isn't as heartless as she tries to make herself out to be? So she does care about Pyro-1... but she didn't mean to show it in front of you...

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Right answer. Now's our chance to get through to her. You, my little friends, are the only ones who can get her back onto the right path.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But Haniyyah's long gone now. Where should we look for her?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Well, right now, I'm sure she must be wondering what it is that has made her suddenly start doubting herself after all this time.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: The answer lies with the three of you. I'm sure you all know where she's gone to.

choices.text: Paimon, Layla, and me?

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: #The place where I first met {NICKNAME} and Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good point... it was when Layla mentioned her plan to bring her shroom buddies back home with her that Haniyyah's mood suddenly changed... Layla, it seems like you're on to something!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's catch up with Haniyyah and set things straight!

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: You should stay here, Little Layla. I understand that you want to help Haniyyah, but she's not the kind of person you're good at dealing with. Leave it to them this time.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: That's true... And if I said something that struck a nerve again, I'd only make things worse. Plus, you guys move pretty fast... If I tag along, I'd probably need to stop and gather my strength every 10 minutes...

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Well, what are you waiting for, little one?

choices.text: This is everything we've dug up so far.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Oh? My, you've been busier than I thought.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: In return, I give you a blessing from me: Good luck. I'll share my thoughts the next time we meet.

choices.text: Please take a look and see what you think.
Wait, you mean...?
Defenses?

talks.objective: Go to the place mentioned in the conversation

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That didn't go as planned... Well, there's only one option left: we gotta defeat Haniyyah in the final match.

choices.text: At least we got to know how she really feels.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Didn't Haniyyah mention something about other researchers in the past trying to stop the damage caused by Fungi, too? There should be more information in this notebook. Let's take a look.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: These look like... research notes. Guess Haniyyah's ancestors kept them after the scholars left...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew... This section looks super complicated. The handwriting is really bad, and there are too many technical terms... Paimon can't make heads or tails of this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, some of these look familiar though... Oh, that's right, we saw them on the documents Dori gave us!

choices.text: So the notes and the documents are connected.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright! Let's put them side by side, go through carefully, and try to figure out what's written in these notes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A capturing device? And a Withering Potion?

choices.text: The device used to capture the Fungi made them calm and approachable.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's how it went down... The Fungi only attacked Haniyyah's ancestors because of what that potion did to them... And then the researchers built that device to try and capture the angry Fungi.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Also, if Floral Jelly is just an improved version of the Withering Potion, and the Wisdom Orb isn't Kautilya's invention either...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...He's basically giving someone else's inventions a new name and passing them off as his own. He's a big fat liar!

choices.text: A big fat liar indeed!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why is Kautilya so eager to get people to use the Wisdom Orb, anyway?

choices.text: Maybe he wants to finish the work started by scholars that went before him...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We've gotta warn Elchingen. He needs to stop bankrolling Kautilya right away!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As for Haniyyah... She has no idea that the Fungi only attacked her ancestors because they were under the potion's influence. No wonder she holds it against them...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, Bongo-Head. Paimon knows you're not gonna turn evil because of some Floral Jelly. You stayed a very good Fungus, even after we turned off the Wisdom Orb!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, you can understand what Paimon's saying? Oh wow! You're getting smarter!

choices.text: Paimon, wait...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Since when!? Paimon didn't even notice...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Does that mean... Bongo-Head is hanging out with us by choice right now?

choices.text: It's had a good experience with us so far.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: See, see! Haniyyah was wrong after all, the Fungi aren't gonna lose control this time. Some Fungi understand people and just wanna get along, like Bongo-Head here!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Haniyyah did make one good point, though: The Wisdom Orb has its limits. As long as that's the case, Fungi won't be able to live with humans forever.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aww... Paimon was really hoping Bongo-Head could join us for the rest of our journey... Isn't there a way?

choices.text: Let's keep a safe distance from them now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... It's a shame, but it seems like there's no other choice.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We still have some time before the final. Should we report Kautilya to the Akademiya?

choices.text: We don't know what he's capable of.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: True... For him to have made it this far, he must've been planning for a long time. If he caught wind of our plans to expose him, he'd definitely be wary of us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whatever else happens, we have to give it our all on the day of the final. Let's beat Haniyyah, and knock some sense into her. Then, we should get Elchingen to help us expose Kautilya for the fraud he is!

choices.text: We also don't want to let him know we're onto him.
Let's look for ways to improve the Wisdom Orb...
We've gained a mutual understanding.
The Wisdom Orb isn't active.
...But more likely, he just wants to take credit for other people's work.
Although, I can't say I'm that surprised.
But the Withering Potion made them go berserk.
Let's try putting everything together.
At least we got her notebook.
